violations.why: The task masks interrupt 2, but irq_zenith preempts it and calls enable_isr(2). irq_indigo can then run between the task's write at 45 and its write at 48, and it reads v_quartz[TRIGGER] when v_willow is 1. It sees the 0 from line 45 instead of the 1 from line 48.

Once interrupt 2 has been enabled, for example by an earlier run of irq_zenith, irq_indigo (priority 2) can preempt irq_zenith between its two writes. It then reads the intermediate value 0 instead of 1.
